rooms.13040: Shelves of black oak climb into the gloom of the Grand Hall Of Records, each one crowded with scroll cases, ledgers and cracked tablets that chronicle the kings of Durmandel. Dust lies thick on the reading desks, and a cold, dry smell of old parchment hangs in the air. A single archway opens east onto a long corridor, and the dim light from it barely reaches the farthest stacks.
rooms.13117: A Long Corridor runs here between walls hung with the faded banners of Durmandel's royal houses, their dwarf-forged thread gone dull as ash. Worn flagstones, polished by centuries of royal feet, echo faintly underfoot. Archways open north into the Throne Hall and east toward a chapel, while the corridor stretches on south and a door of the records hall stands to the west.
rooms.13118: The Throne Hall is a vast chamber of grey granite pillars carved with the beards and axes of dwarf kings. A great stone throne sits on a dais at its heart, its arms worn smooth, the cushion long since rotted to threads. Cold braziers stand cracked and empty on every side. Archways lead west into the Royal Hall, east to a broad stair, and south back to the corridor.
rooms.13137: You stand at the foot of a broad stair at the end of the Throne Hall, where the floor is scattered with flakes of old plaster fallen from the ceiling. A tight, winding flight of narrow steps climbs from the corner of the landing, its treads hollowed by many feet. A wide arch leads back west into the Throne Hall, and a broad marble stair leads away east.
rooms.13198: The Grand Stairway is a sweeping flight of marble steps, each one as wide as a wagon and carved along its edges with a frieze of marching dwarves. A pair of great bronze doors, long since green with age, stand open to the hall behind you at the west. Below, the stairs plunge in a wide spiral down into the darkness of the old mines, and a faint warm draught breathes up from the deep.
rooms.13138: This narrow stairway winds tightly upward through the thickness of the wall, its steps no wider than a pair of boots. The stone is bare and sweating, and the only light is the faint glow that filters up from the landing below. Scratched marks of long-dead sentries cover the walls at shoulder height, tally upon tally. The stair climbs on and drops back toward the foot of the grand stair.
rooms.13139: The narrow stairway turns sharply in the wall, forming a tiny landing no larger than a cupboard. An arrow slit in the stone lets in a thin blade of daylight, and a few dead leaves have blown in to rest on the step. The air is cooler here and smells faintly of wind and bird droppings. The stairs go on climbing, and descend again toward the lower flight.
rooms.13140: The last turns of the narrow stairway end in a low, steep flight where the walls are stained with old streaks of white. A strong draught pours down from above, carrying the wild cry of some large bird. Loose feathers, long and tawny, are stuck in the cracks of the steps. The stair rises to a doorway of grey sky, and falls back the way you came.
rooms.13141: The Look-Out is a ring of crumbling battlement on the highest tower of Durmandel's halls, open to the sky and a restless wind. Far below, the mountain valleys fold away in blue distance, and mist drifts between the peaks. A rusted iron brazier stands in the centre, filled with old ash and grey feathers. The stair drops back into the tower, and a narrow ledge of rock leads west along the cliff.
rooms.13142: A Rocky Ledge clings to the mountain face here, a shelf of wind-scoured stone barely wide enough for a single traveller. Beyond the lip, the drop plunges into a haze of cloud and distant crags. Patches of orange lichen cover the rock, and old claw-marks gouge the stone near your feet. The ledge leads on west and returns east to the battlements of the Look-Out.
rooms.13143: The ledge narrows as it bends around a shoulder of the mountain, the rock slick with spray and wind-driven grit. Bones of goats and mountain sheep lie scattered along the base of the cliff, picked clean and bleached white. A heavy musk of beast and carrion hangs on the wind. The path leads east back to another stretch of the ledge, and west toward a great jumble of sticks and fur.
rooms.13144: The Gryphon's Nest is a broad bowl of woven branches, bones and shed feathers, wedged into a hollow of the cliff and as wide as a feast table. The floor is lined with thick matted down, strewn with the gnawed remains of mountain goats. Wind howls across the open lip of the hollow, and the sky is a distant blue. The only way out is the ledge winding away east.
rooms.13119: The Royal Hall is a long hall of dark stone, its high ceiling hung with the tattered remains of silk pennants. A strip of faded crimson carpet runs down the middle, worn thin along the line where courtiers once walked. Tall windows of grey glass cast a dim, watery light across the floor. An archway on the east side opens to the Throne Hall, and another passage runs west toward the queen's chamber, while the hall continues north.
rooms.13120: The royal hall ends here in a high, shadowed alcove where the pennants hang in rotted tatters from iron poles. A heavy table of ironwood stands against the wall, its surface carved with the runes of Durmandel's long dynasty. Dust motes drift in the pale light of a narrow window. A studded oak door leads west into the king's chamber, and the hall runs back south.
rooms.13121: The King's Bed Chamber holds a vast bed of carved ironwood, hung with curtains of heavy brocade gone brittle and brown. Rich tapestries of hunts and battles cover the walls, though moths have eaten holes through the dwarf warriors' faces. A heavy iron-bound chest, long since opened and emptied, lies at the foot of the bed. The only way out is the door east, back into the royal hall.
rooms.13122: The Queen's Bed Chamber is a small, high room hung with pale blue silk that has faded to the colour of ash. A dressing table of inlaid bone stands before a clouded mirror, its drawers hanging open and empty. Dried petals lie in a crust across the floor, and the faint ghost of lavender still lingers in the cold air. The one doorway opens east onto the Royal Hall.
rooms.13123: The Chapel is a quiet vaulted room where rows of stone benches face an altar of white marble veined with grey. Narrow windows of coloured glass throw faded patches of red and blue across the floor. A basin of stagnant water stands by the altar, and a tarnished hammer-and-anvil symbol hangs on the wall behind. The corridor lies west, and a heavy door leads east into a chamber that smells of spice and rot.
rooms.13124: The Embalming Chamber is lined with long slabs of cold stone, each one grooved to drain away the water of the dead. Racks along the walls hold glass jars of dry herbs, bundles of linen strips, and rusted hooks and knives. A sharp smell of resin, myrrh and old decay clings to everything. A door west leads out to the chapel, and an opening north leads deeper in toward the royal dead.
rooms.13125: The Burial Chamber is cut into a series of shallow burial niches, each one holding a stone coffin carved with the face of a long-dead noble. Bronze lamps hang from the ceiling on chains, though none have burned for an age. The air is utterly still and bitterly cold, and your breath hangs before you in a pale cloud. The embalmers' work lies south, and the chamber goes on north.
rooms.13126: The far end of the burial chamber is lined with stone coffins stacked in heavy tiers, each marked with a name in dwarf runes. Garlands of dead flowers crumble on the lids, and a few have slipped to scatter petals across the stone. The silence is thick and watchful, as though the dead are waiting. A heavy door stands to the north, leading to a hall of honoured warriors, and the chamber ends south toward the embalmers.
rooms.13127: The Hall Of Heroes is a high, echoing gallery where statues of dwarf champions stand in rows on plinths, each gripping a weapon of worn stone. Their names are carved beneath them, and many have been scoured by weeping and pilgrimage. Battle-torn banners droop from the rafters above. Passages of the hall run east and west, a door leads north into a walled place, and the burial chambers lie south.
rooms.13133: A Nameless Place lies beyond the door, a small walled court of bare flagstones where nothing grows. A single slab of black stone stands in the centre, its face polished smooth and without a mark or a letter. The sky above is a leaden, silent grey, and the wind seems to avoid the place. The only way out is the door south, back into the hall.
rooms.13128: This eastern reach of the Hall Of Heroes is lined with more statues, their faces pitted by long ages of damp. A ring of worn shields hangs from the wall, each one dented by a battle no one now remembers. The floor is laid with stones of black and white, in the pattern of a chessboard. Low openings lead north, east and south onto mounds of earth, and the hall runs back west.
rooms.13129: The western arm of the Hall Of Heroes is a gallery of weapons, with racks of notched axes and mattocks rusting where they hang. A long mosaic along the wall shows dwarves marching to war beneath a mountain. Grains of earth have drifted in from the mounds beyond and settled in the corners. Openings lead north, south and west to mounds outside, while the hall runs east toward its centre.
rooms.13134: A Burial Mound rises here, a grassy hump of earth ringed with a low wall of fitted stones. A cracked headstone leans at the foot of the mound, its rune-carved face weathered almost smooth. The grass is thin and silvered with frost, and a damp chill breathes out of the soil. Only the gallery of the Hall Of Heroes lies south, back through a low arch.
rooms.13135: A Burial Mound swells here beneath a single leaning pine, its roots gripping the stones of an old cairn. Cold white pebbles are scattered over the earth, and a bronze axe-head, green with age, is set into the turf as a marker. The wind sighs through the needles, and somewhere a crow croaks. The hall gallery is the only way out, a short step west.
rooms.13136: A Burial Mound slumps here, its turf sunken as though something below had settled. A ring of weathered standing stones circles it, each cut with the same rune of mourning. Brown thistles push through the cracks, and a thin mist clings to the hollow. The only path leads north, back through a low arch into the Hall Of Heroes.
rooms.13132: A Burial Mound lies here in the shade of the great hall wall, its earth heaped over a low stone cist. Moss as thick as a blanket covers the stones, and drops of water fall slowly from the dripping eaves. The air smells of wet clay and old iron. The way back lies south, where an arm of the Hall Of Heroes waits.
rooms.13130: A Burial Mound is heaped here under a low sky, bare of all growth except a few stalks of pale, dry grass. A shattered urn of grey clay lies broken against the mound's flank, and a scatter of black beads mixes with the dirt around it. Wind moans in a crack of the great wall. The gallery lies north, the only way from this lonely place.
rooms.13131: A Burial Mound stands here near the edge of the court, tucked against a corner of the great wall. Tufts of rust-coloured heather cover its crown, and a cluster of small, pale mushrooms grows at its foot. Ancient offerings of coin and rusted nails are sunk in the soil. The only way out is east, back into the hall.
rooms.13116: A Long Corridor stretches here between close walls of cold, damp stone. A bare iron sconce hangs every few paces, though not one still holds a torch. The floor is scattered with scraps of rotted cloth and a few small bones, as if something had passed this way long ago. The corridor leads north toward the throne chambers, and south to the end of a long hallway.
rooms.13115: The long hallway comes to its end here at a landing of worn flagstones, with a broad stairway falling steeply away into the dark. The steps are cut from pale stone, and a cold breath from below stirs the cobwebs at the edge. A dwarf-made lantern hook juts from the wall, empty and rusted. The corridor leads north, and the grand stairs lead down toward the older halls.

13118.description: The throne is hewn from one block of grey granite, its back carved with a mountain and a crown. Deep grooves in the arms show where gauntleted hands once gripped them.

13133.description: The black slab bears no name, no rune and no date. Though the stone is cold, it feels oddly smooth, as if many hands have touched it.

creatures.long_desc: A crumbling skeleton guard in rusted mail stands rigid at its post, a notched halberd in its bony hands.
creatures.description: The bones are yellow with age and held together by little more than will. Faded royal livery hangs in rags from its ribs.

creatures.long_desc: A restless ghost drifts through the cold air, wringing hands that are no more than smoke.
creatures.description: The pale shape of a long-dead courtier wavers before you, its mouth open in a soundless wail. Its robes flutter in a wind that you cannot feel.

creatures.long_desc: A hooded embalmer cultist shuffles about the slabs, muttering over a jar of resin.
creatures.description: A gaunt figure in a stained grey robe, with hands blackened by years of resin and spice. A curved bone knife hangs from a cord at his belt.

creatures.short_desc: a skeletal hero in rusted plate
creatures.long_desc: A skeletal hero in rusted plate armour stands among the statues, a great hammer held ready.
creatures.description: The skeleton of a dwarf champion, still wearing a battered breastplate and a helm crowned with a ring of tarnished gold. Pale green fire burns in its empty eye sockets.

creatures.long_desc: A great gryphon crouches on the rock, its hooked beak open and its eagle eyes fixed on you.
creatures.description: A huge beast with the body of a lion and the wings and head of a mountain eagle. Its talons scrape the stone with a sound like knives on a whetstone.

creatures.short_desc: Orlen, the ghost of the Archivist
creatures.long_desc: Orlen, the ghost of the Archivist, glides between the shelves, a quill of smoke in his hand.
creatures.description: A spectral scholar in a hooded robe, his face a gaunt mask of mist and sorrow. Ink drips endlessly from his fingertips and vanishes before it strikes the floor.

creatures.long_desc: Durgrim, the undead Dwarf King, sits upon his granite throne, a crowned skeleton wreathed in cold fire.
creatures.description: The bones of a mighty king, bound in a mantle of rotted ermine and crowned with a heavy circlet of iron. He grips a mighty axe, and his hollow gaze burns with a terrible white light.

items.room_desc: A gilded death mask lies here, staring at nothing.
items.description: A thin mask of beaten gold, shaped to the calm face of a dwarf noble. It is worth a good price to the right buyer.

items.room_desc: A hero's warhammer lies here, its haft worn dark.
items.description: A heavy dwarf-forged warhammer with a head of grey steel stamped with a mountain rune. The grip has been worn smooth by a champion's hands.

items.room_desc: A tawny cloak of gryphon feathers lies here.
items.description: A light cloak woven from the long tawny feathers of a mountain gryphon. It rustles like a breeze in the high crags.

items.room_desc: A silver signet ring lies here, engraved with a quill.
items.description: A heavy silver ring bearing the seal of Durmandel's keeper of records. Ink-black runes wind about the band.

items.room_desc: A heavy iron crown lies here, rimed in cold frost.
items.description: A broad circlet of black iron, set with a single grey gem and engraved with the names of forty kings. It is cold to the touch and strangely heavy.
